flags: PHONE: stored 403-854-7275 matches 'SAB Parks Info Line 403-854-PARK (403-854-7275)' and Google Maps (4.6 from 297 reviews). Website https://specialareas.ab.ca/visit/parks-campgrounds/prairie-oasis-park/ answered 200; the brochure PDF answered 200.
BROCHURE RULES (2026): 'Tents must be re-sited after 3 days if on grassy areas'; 'fishing is not permitted'; one-way loop traffic - nothing that affects keeping it.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - keep): the treed camping loops south of the park road sit on a point of the reservoir; the southern row is ~40-55 m from the water but behind the park's day-use beach (docks, groomed 'large, sandy beach') and a perimeter lane, and the south-east edge has a continuous tree belt at the shore - no on-water. Open view across the day-use beach is plausible from the southern row. The four newer circular loops north of the road are ~300 m+ from the water. Lakeview stands; no change.
PIN (51.45960,-111.81970): on the park road along the north edge of the treed loops, ~70 m from sites (Google's point 51.45975,-111.82487 is ~360 m west at the entrance area). No move.
